action_resume_retry_count.description: action.resumeRetryCount (as documented in the shipped file). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#action.resumeRetryCount="-1"    # infinite retries if host is down).

file_create_mode.default: "0644" # Set the access permissions for the state file

queue_filename.description: queue.filename (as documented in the shipped file). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#queue.filename="fwdRule1"       # unique name prefix for spool files).

queue_maxdiskspace.description: queue.maxdiskspace (as documented in the shipped file). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#queue.maxdiskspace="1g"         # 1gb space limit (use as much as possible)).

queue_saveonshutdown.description: queue.saveonshutdown (as documented in the shipped file). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#queue.saveonshutdown="on"       # save messages to disk on shutdown).

queue_type.description: queue.type (as documented in the shipped file). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#queue.type="LinkedList"         # run asynchronously).

state_file.description: StateFile (as documented in the shipped file).
state_file.default: "imjournal.state") # File to store the position in the journal

sys_sock_use.description: SysSock.Use (as documented in the shipped file).
sys_sock_use.default: "off") # Turn off message reception via local log socket;

target.description: Target (as documented in the shipped file). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#Target="remote_host" Port="XXX" Protocol="tcp")).

use_pid.description: UsePid (as documented in the shipped file).
use_pid.default: "system" # PID nummber is retrieved as the ID of the process the journal entry originates from
